name: Yakumo Aira
source:
She graduated from the same university as Shichirouta five years ago.

She was previously married, and got divorced last month.

She ran into Shichirouta by chance at the university’s career services office.

[from [url=https://winters.world.coocan.jp/newpage3070.html]official site[/url]]
